review_summary: The concealed under-seater lighting is visually too dominant. The nearly continuous warm luminous ribbon competes with the intended lighting hierarchy rather than quietly supporting the seating.
required_changes: Pull the brightest emission further underneath the seating.
Conceal the apparent source more convincingly.
Preserve a subtle warm reflected pool on the floor.
Reduce the visual reach of the under-seat glow.
The effect should gently detach the seating from the floor rather than trace the furniture geometry.
hard_locks: Do not advance to another layer.
